proposed_evidence_label: confirmed static invariant violation; runtime failure injection unavailable
reason: Both pinned runner revisions build and install workspace wheels before installed-graph verification. The verification result is appended to checks without an immediate return, after which repository checks, CLI imports, independent tests and the synthetic workflow continue. The successful exact-head CI graph is a success-path control, not a failure-path test.
expected: Locked runtime dependencies and workspace origins are proved before any repository build hook, import, test or workflow; any verification failure stops immediately.
actual: runner_workload.py e0181fc lines 354-444 and 449-598 builds/installs first and continues after the failed check; cd4d43b has the same ordering.
impact: A drifted or wrong installed graph can still execute untrusted repository code and produce later evidence; no actual drift, credential exposure or incorrect product result was observed in the green CI run.
missing_evidence: Untouched-container injected version/origin mismatch proving no later subprocess starts after a correction; complete unexpected-distribution inventory.
acceptance: Verify base image dependencies before workspace wheel build; verify workspace origins immediately after install; make both hard gates. Inject version and origin failures and assert no subsequent repository command; keep a matching success control.
unresolved_questions: Whether the base-image dependency graph can be separated from workspace-origin verification without importing workspace packages
Whether unexpected installed distributions should be rejected or merely inventoried
